description: Source freshness and bulk-snapshot health. This endpoint downgrades itself when its own arithmetic says stale — it never guesses green. When state is 'degraded', degraded_reasons names each cause with its measurement; sources[].index_reconciliation says whether the government's own index lists filings not yet served; bulk_export.merkle_root is the day's commitment over every row's content_hash, for verifying a bulk download.
name: get_status
